reviews.text: Colors are really pretty to look at but unfortunately it just doesn’t look that great on me. The colors aren’t easy to use and though the glitters are really pretty the entire look falls apart pretty easily.
reviews.zh: 顏色望落真係好靚，但可惜上到我塊面就唔係咁好睇。顏色唔容易用，雖然閃粉真係好靚，但成個妝好快就散晒。

reviews.text:
The prettiest palette I own!

The powders are really silky and soft. The lighter shades are decently pigmented and can be built up, and the glitters are beautiful. Most of the glitter shades are pretty fine, the slightly more chunkier glitter being the top middle shade.

Overall it's a really nice cool toned pink palette to have. I like using the light pink over my lid, then the berry color on the outer corners, then a glitter in the middle.

The ice cream nail polish is a really cute addition and the ice cream theme is just really adorable!
reviews.zh:
我手入面最靚嘅眼影盤！

粉質真係絲滑柔軟。淺色顯色度適中，可以疊加，閃粉好靚。大部分閃粉色號都好幼細，稍微大粒少少嘅就係正中間嗰個色號。

整體嚟講，呢個冷調粉紅色眼影盤好值得擁有。我鍾意用淺粉紅掃成個眼蓋，再用莓果色掃眼尾，最後中間點閃粉。

雪糕指甲油係好可愛嘅 bonus，雪糕主題真係超級 cute！

reviews.text:
I highly recommend Milk Latte to people with cushion shade #21 or above. I'm a #13 and I find the colour payoff to be beautifully soft and very suitable for elegant daily makeup. The shades consist of milky coffee beige colours, some of which are more yellow based and some more pink, but overall the palette feels neutral leaning warm that would suit most people. I own most Dasique palettes, but this one is special with it's glitters - they're beautiful and subtle pearls with an amazingly silky and smooth formula. 
This palette is less pink and a bit softer than Nude Potion - both are gorgeous, but Milk Latte is lighter and more yellow-ish overall.

I'd really recommend getting the Awards version while it's available because the Espresso single shade that comes with this is so useful for all sorts of makeup and blends out and draws eyeliner perfectly!
reviews.zh:
我強烈推薦 cushion 粉底用 #21 或以上色號嘅人揀 Milk Latte。我自己係 #13，我覺得呢盤嘅顯色度柔和靚絕，好啱優雅日常妝。色號由奶啡米色組成，有啲偏黃，有啲偏粉，但整體盤感係中性偏暖，大部分人都啱用。我有齊大部分 Dasique 眼影盤，但呢盤特別之處在於佢嘅閃粉——靚到唔止，仲係細緻嘅珍珠光，粉質絲滑到令人驚嘆。
呢盤比 Nude Potion 冇咁粉，柔和少少——兩盤都係靚，但 Milk Latte 整體偏淺偏黃少少。

強烈建議喺仲有貨嘅時候入手 Awards 版本，因為跟機嘅 Espresso 單色眼影真係萬用，無論咩妝都啱用，推開容易，畫眼線都一流！

reviews.text: Like every Dasique palette, Nude Potion has a beautiful colour story alongside one of the best formulas in k-beauty. The formula got even better after Milk Latte's release, but it's still amazing here. Nude Potion is a little bit less pink than it is in the pictures, but it's still much less yellow than Milk Latte. It consists of warm-leaning-neutral beige and brown shades with stunning golden glitters. I think even cool tones would look great in this, it's a very universally flattering palette. Perfect for days when you want a simple and quick but classically beautiful look.
reviews.zh: 同其他 Dasique 眼影盤一樣，Nude Potion 嘅色彩故事靚絕，仲配搭咗韓妝入面數一數二嘅配方。Milk Latte 出咗之後，配方仲再靚咗，但呢盤本身已經好出色。Nude Potion 實際上比相入面睇落冇咁粉，但仍然比 Milk Latte 黃少好多。整盤由偏暖中性嘅米色同棕色組成，配上令人眼前一亮嘅金色閃粉。我覺得就算冷調膚色用都會好靚，係一款極度百搭嘅眼影盤。想簡單快捷又要經典靚嘅日子用呢款就啱晒。

reviews.text: Violet Knit is a neutral, mauve pink palette that is perfect for warm and cool tones. 01 and 02 are matte bases with fine shimmer. A bit chalky but pretty for subtle shimmer. Almost no difference in colour. 03 and 09 are both sparkly glitters with sheer colour base. They’re very reflective and dimensional. 03 is an ice, silvery pink, 09 has golden specks mixed with the purple. 04 is matte purple with a fine shimmer. Less shimmery than 01 and 09 and a bit chalky. 05, 06 and 07 are smooth, buttery mattes with a buildable formula. The lighter shades are a little sheer but building is no issue. 08 is a chunky, glittery light purple-pink with no colour base. There is so much dimension and makes a nice statement for the eyes. It’s very soft and foil-like in the pan to the touch. The free brush gift is also good quality and is good for detailed work. It’s a unique, good quality palette as pink/purple palettes tend to lean cool, but this one would be suitable for warm tones as well.
reviews.zh: Violet Knit 係一款中性、mauve 粉色眼影盤，冷暖調都啱用。01 同 02 係帶有細緻閃粉嘅霧面底色。有少少粉感，但做細緻閃光效果幾靚。兩個顏色幾乎一樣。03 同 09 都係有通透底色嘅閃粉。非常反射同有立體感。03 係一款冰感銀粉色，09 將金色斑點混進紫色入面。04 係帶細緻閃粉嘅霧面紫。比 01 同 09 閃粉少啲，又有少少粉感。05、06 同 07 都係滑溜、牛油質感嘅霧面色，配方可疊加。淺色有少少通透但疊加冇問題。08 係一款大粒、閃粉感重、冇底色嘅淺紫粉色。立體感十足，喺眼上好搶眼。摸落盤入面非常柔軟，似金屬片。跟機送嘅掃都好有質素，適合做細緻工作。粉紫調眼影盤多數偏冷調，但呢一款比較獨特同時質素高，暖調膚色都啱用。

reviews.text: Dasqiue eyeshadow palettes were my most exciting find of 2020. I’ve been collecting their palettes ever since. I love love love their formula bc the powder is milled super super fine. They pack a punch while remaining sheer and aren’t chalky - like you don’t notice that you have powder on your lid like you would in western palettes. Dasique really set the standard for quality now that I’ve tried their palettes. Their color stories are also really pretty and wearable. While the new palettes may feel redundant, I noticed that they’re trying new formulations. I got this one since it has the most amount of glitter formula out of all the new releases. While this isn’t my favorite palette since it came with those chunky glitters, but the quality is still there so I don’t regret the purchase.
reviews.zh: Dasique 眼影盤係我 2020 年最興奮嘅發現。自此我就一直儲緊佢哋嘅眼影盤。我勁愛勁愛勁愛佢哋嘅配方，因為粉磨得超幼細。顯色度十足但仍然通透，唔會有粉感——同歐美眼影盤唔同，你唔會感覺到眼蓋上面有粉。試過佢哋嘅眼影盤之後，Dasique 真係為質素定咗標準。佢哋嘅色彩故事都好靚好實用。雖然新嘅眼影盤可能會覺得重複，但我留意到佢哋有新配方嘅嘗試。買咗呢盤因為喺所有新出嘅眼影盤入面，佢嘅閃粉配方佔比最多。雖然呢盤唔係我最愛嘅眼影盤（因為嗰啲大粒閃粉），但質素依然在，所以都唔後悔買咗。

reviews.text: I have almost all of Dasique’s palettes (yes don’t judge but I love their formula and use it everyday) and flower book’s formula is different to the rest of the palettes. It’s obviously very cute and beautiful, feels very romantic and has a nice weight to it. But formula wise, it’s nothing like the 9 pan shadows. The colour story is nice but the glitters aren’t pigmented. It’s not high shine and intensely sparkly like the others. Also powdery. However it’s good if you don’t mind and want a less pigmented glitter. It can be wearable for everyday without bringing too much attention. All in all, the formula of the Flower Book palette is not great, but still fine for everyday use and a nice colour story for spring. Gorgeous packing slightly redeems itself a bit. I gave 5 stars as I highly recommend the other palettes from Dasique (I highly recommend Sugar Brownie, Rose Petal, Sunset Muhly and Autumn Breeze).
reviews.zh: 我差唔多有齊 Dasique 所有眼影盤（係呀唔好 judge，但我真係好鍾意佢哋嘅配方，日日都用），Flower Book 嘅配方同其他眼影盤唔同。佢明顯非常 cute 又靚，感覺好浪漫，拎上手有啲重量。但喺配方方面，同 9 色眼影完全唔同。色彩故事係靚嘅，但閃粉唔顯色。唔似其他眼影盤咁高光又閃爛。而且有粉感。不過如果你唔介意，想用顯色度低啲嘅閃粉都係好嘅。日常用都唔會太搶眼。總括嚟講，Flower Book 眼影盤嘅配方唔算好，但日常用仲得，而且有春日氣息嘅靚色彩故事。包裝靚到稍稍補返啲分。俾咗 5 星因為我好推薦 Dasique 其他眼影盤（特別推薦 Sugar Brownie、Rose Petal、Sunset Muhly 同 Autumn Breeze）。

reviews.text: Autumn Breeze is a stunning neutral cool toned palette. I love the colour story but be warned, just like a lot of the other colour stories, the shades are very very light. I have light-medium skin and the three matte shades on the top right are like base eyeshadow shades. Only the matte grey and deep brown show up well but even then, it’s still very sheer. I buy Dasique primarily for the stunning jelly glitters. They are incredibly high shine and sparkly. Pretty much the best jelly glitter formula in the kbeauty market. Even against my Hu** beauty palette, the glitters in here are even more intensely high shine and sparkly which is crazy to me. Highly highly recommend these palettes. #10 Autumn Breeze is great for cooler toned/sparkly grey looks.
reviews.zh: Autumn Breeze 係一款令人眼前一亮嘅中性冷調眼影盤。我好鍾意佢嘅色彩故事，但要提一提，同其他好多色彩故事一樣，色號都係非常非常淺。我嘅膚色係淺至中等，右上角嗰三隻霧面色基本上係底妝色號。淨係得霧面灰同深啡先顯色，但顯色到都仲係好通透。我買 Dasique 主要係為咗佢哋嘅 jelly 閃粉。閃粉非常光猛、非常閃爛。基本上係韓妝市場入面最好嘅 jelly 閃粉配方。對比我自己嘅 Hu** beauty 眼影盤，呢盤嘅閃粉仲要更高光更閃爛，對我嚟講真係難以置信。極度極度推薦呢啲眼影盤。#10 Autumn Breeze 最適合冷調／閃爛灰色妝容。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
